title: Director, School Counseling and University Admissions
description:
Want to revolutionize the future of education and do meaningful work that transforms future generations' lives?

Our team is looking to bring on passionate educators to support our growing student base through part-time teaching roles. This position offers the opportunity to teach bright, motivated students from around the world while maintaining flexibility in your schedule. You'll play a key role in delivering high-quality, personalized learning experiences as we continue to expand our reach globally

POSITION OVERVIEW

We are seeking a Director of School Counseling and University Admissions to serve as a critical bridge between our A-level and US curriculum pathways. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on student counseling to ensure every CGA student receives world-class university guidance while building scalable systems that maintain excellence as we grow.

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in both US and UK education systems, demonstrated success in placing students in top universities globally, and the vision to create comprehensive programs that develop future-ready students. This role requires someone who can work directly with students requiring personalized counseling while simultaneously building the infrastructure, playbooks, and training materials that enable consistent counseling quality across our global team.

Purpose

Support students across both curriculum pathways (A-level and US) to help ensure a unified approach to setting students up for success and consistency of practice for academic excellence. This role acts as a bridge between the two curriculum pathways, ensuring that students have the support they need to choose the path that best aligns with their future goals. You'll provide hands-on student counseling support for top universities, support clubs, create enrichment programs, and build scalable systems to ensure students arrive at the application stage well-prepared with strong academic foundations, examination results, rich extracurricular profiles, global competencies in real-world experiences, and clear university pathways aligned to personal goals and CGA's institutional strengths.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Cross-Pathway Leadership & Coordination

  • Facilitate knowledge sharing and best practice exchange between campuses and across curriculum types (A-level and US pathways)

  • Collaborate with academic staff, admissions teams, and deans to align curricular offerings with student outcomes and market demand

  • Monitor and benchmark academic performance across campuses and curricula to drive continuous improvement

  • Ensure consistency of practice for academic excellence across both curriculum pathways

  • Work as part of an extended team across time zones to support our global nature

    • Examination Management & Academic Performance

  • Support examination management across A-levels, AP, and SAT programs

  • Develop and oversee comprehensive exam preparation programs across all curricula

  • Implement data-driven strategies to improve student outcomes

  • Support accreditation and compliance for institutional relationships

    • Academic Enrichment & Future-Ready Student Development

  • Create programs that develop globally competitive students prepared for the future of work

  • Support and coordinate academic competitions to build student competitiveness

  • Develop real-world experiences and vibrant community connections for students

  • Support student clubs and enrichment programs

  • Ensure students develop strong academic foundations, rich extracurricular profiles, and global competencies

  • Build connections between students and opportunities that develop future-ready skills

    • Clubs & Extracurricular Programs

  • Design and implement a comprehensive club structure and system across CGA that ensures consistency and quality

  • Support student clubs and organizations to foster community connection in a virtual environment

  • Create frameworks and guidelines for club formation, leadership, and sustainability

  • Develop and maintain a diverse portfolio of extracurricular opportunities aligned with university admissions expectations

  • Ensure student leadership development through club participation and officer roles

  • Monitor club engagement and participation to identify opportunities for student connection

  • Build partnerships with external organizations to provide authentic extracurricular experiences

  • Track and document student extracurricular involvement for university applications

  • Create virtual and asynchronous club opportunities that accommodate students across time zones

    • Direct University Admissions Counseling

  • Deliver world-class university admissions counseling through direct student support

  • Work directly with a select cohort of high-intensity students requiring comprehensive personalized counseling

  • Provide strategic planning for university applications, including subject selection and pathway decisions

  • Manage predicted grades and letters of recommendation for students

  • Guide students through UCAS, Common App, and country-specific application systems

  • Ensure students meet all deadlines across multiple application systems globally

  • Review and provide feedback on personal statements, essays, and supplemental materials

  • Provide comprehensive guidance on university selection across US, UK, Canadian, European, Australian, Asian, and other international systems

  • Coordinate financial aid and scholarship applications with families

  • Maintain current knowledge of admissions requirements, deadlines, and trends across global universities

    • Building Scalable Systems & Infrastructure

  • Build scalable systems that ensure all CGA students receive expert guidance through their application process

  • Create comprehensive counseling playbooks and frameworks for counselors and deans to follow

  • Develop standardized processes for predicted grades, recommendation letters, and application quality assurance

  • Build training materials and resources to establish consistent counseling quality across the team

  • Establish quality standards and benchmarks for university counseling

  • Design asynchronous resources supporting part-time students through their application journeys

  • Develop and maintain an extensive database of university programs, scholarships, and requirements globally

  • Build systems that can evolve as our school grows

    • Data & Performance Tracking

  • Support data dashboards tracking application progress and outcomes for areas of improvement

  • Ensure data is transparent and reportable across all school leadership

  • Track and analyze university admissions outcomes to inform program improvements

  • Generate reports on student outcomes and program metrics

  • Use data to identify trends and optimize counseling strategies

    • Strategic Partnerships & Market Intelligence

  • Monitor global education and admissions trends to adjust CGA's approach and maintain competitive advantage

  • Cultivate relationships with university admissions offices to enhance CGA's institutional reputation

  • Build partnerships with universities to create opportunities for CGA students

  • Represent CGA at virtual university fairs and recruitment events

  • Stay informed about test-optional policies, holistic admissions trends, and evolving university requirements

    • Student Support & Academic Advising

  • Advise students on course rigor, AP subject selection, A-level subject combinations, prerequisites, and graduation requirements

  • Provide counseling to address academic stress, time management, and study skills

  • Support students navigating the unique challenges of online learning

  • Serve as an advocate for student needs within the school community

  • Coordinate with families through virtual information sessions and regular communication

  • Create learning environments where every student discovers and develops their unique strengths

    • Administrative & Compliance

  • Maintain accurate student records and university application tracking systems

  • Prepare school reports, transcripts, and counselor recommendation letters

  • Collaborate with school leadership on policy development and strategic planning

    • LEADERSHIP VALUES & APPROACH

    As a leader across pathways at CGA, this role will need to be an exemplar of our values:

  • Unlock Potential Together: We work collaboratively. No team is an island. Adapt quickly and find solutions that are in the best interests of our families and CGA as a whole. Every student is a VIP. Make decisive actions to propel us forward through a lens of optimism.

  • Rethink, Rebuild: Avoid defaulting to, "We've always done this."Be curious, look outside your sphere of inspiration, and dive into the data for actionable insights. Online is our advantage. Let's make the most of the innovation at our fingertips. Take immediate action to improve always, take accountability, follow through, and get ready to optimize again.

  • Raise the bar, compound impact: Continually strive to be better tomorrow. Have high standards for yourself and those around you. Tackle hard things with grit, take your work seriously, but not yourself. Take the time to document work, proactively share learnings, and multiply others' efforts. Give credit to those making a positive impact.

    • QUALIFICATIONS


    Education & Credentials

  • Master's degree in School Counseling, Guidance Counseling, Higher Education, or related field

  • Valid school counseling credential/license (or equivalent from home country)

  • Demonstrable expertise in both US and UK education systems

    • Experience

  • Minimum 5-7 years of experience in high school college counseling or university admissions

  • Proven track record of successfully placing students in competitive universities globally

  • Experience building scalable systems, frameworks, or programs in an educational setting

  • Experience working with international students or in an international school setting

  • Demonstrated knowledge of university admissions processes in multiple countries (US, UK, Canada, Europe, Asia, Australia)

  • Deep experience with both AP and A-level curriculum pathways

  • Familiarity with online/virtual education delivery

  • Experience with data analysis and using metrics to drive program improvement

    • Knowledge & Skills

  • Expert knowledge of US university admissions (Common App, Coalition App, UC system, liberal arts colleges, Ivy League)

  • Expert knowledge of UK university admissions (UCAS, Russell Group, requirements for Oxbridge)

  • Working knowledge of university systems in Canada, Australia, Europe, and Asia

  • Understanding of international baccalaureate equivalencies and credit transfers

  • Proficiency with student information systems and college planning software (Naviance, Scoir, Cialfo, or similar)

  • Strong knowledge of scholarship and financial aid resources globally

  • Familiarity with FERPA, GDPR, and educational privacy laws

  • Ability to develop training materials, playbooks, and scalable processes

    • Technical & Communication Skills

  • Excellent virtual communication and presentation skills

  • Proficiency with video conferencing platforms (Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams)

  • Strong written communication skills for emails, reports, recommendation letters, and counseling materials

  • Ability to use learning management systems and collaboration tools

  • Digital literacy and comfort with educational technology

  • Experience with data visualization and dashboard creation for tracking outcomes

Digitalizar para Aproximar
pessoas, negócios e toda sociedade, construindo uma nação mais conectada e transformando a vida dos brasileiros. tecnologia,

inovação,

. Referência na telefonia móvel 4G e na banda larga fixa de ultra velocidade, oferecemos a TV por assinatura com mais canais HD do mercado e inúmeros aplicativos online.

description:

Job Description

Join Us as a Clinical Trial Coordinator – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation
We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our global team, you'll have the opportunity to provide administrative and technical support to the Project Team. As a Clinical Trial Coord, you'll support audit readiness by ensuring files are reviewed according to the schedule detailed in the organization's SOP and department guidance document. You will provide administrative support for site activation activities and aid in the development of the critical path for site activation within assigned projects to support rapid site activations. Representing CRG personnel, you may utilize local knowledge, organization systems, external site lists, and sponsor directives to develop and review site lists that are suitable for the strategic needs of feasibility activities and to provide local input into the site tiering process. Additionally, you may act as a buddy during the onboarding phase and provide training to new staff as needed.

What You'll Do:

  • According to the specific role (Central or Local), coordinates, oversees and completes functions on assigned trial(s) activities as detailed on the task matrix.
  • Performs department, Internal, Country and Investigator file reviews as assigned, and documents findings in appropriate system(s).
  • Ensures allocated tasks are performed on time, within budget and to a high-quality standard. Proactively communicates any risks to project leads.
  • Provides system support (i.e., Activate & eTMF) and ensures system databases are always current.
  • Performs administrative tasks on assigned trials, including, but not limited to, timely processing of documents sent to Client (e)TMF as assigned, performing (e)TMF reviews, distributing mass mailings and communications as needed, providing documents and reports to internal team members.

  • Excellent communication skills for interaction with Brazilian and international customers;
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; Spanish is an advantage.

What We Offer
Working at Den Hartogh means joining a global family where your growth matters. We offer:

title: 3º Cozinheiro
description:
Sobre a posição:

Profissional responsável por auxiliar nos preparos dos pratos, atentando para as especificações da comanda ou cardápio. Atua na manipulação e verificação do estado de conservação dos ingredientes utilizados, assegurando o padrão de qualidade e atendimento às exigências dos pedidos. Na ausência do 2º Cozinheiro, auxilia na organização e execução das atividades de cozinha, garantindo o bom andamento dos serviços.

O que você vai fazer?

Preparar refeições e sobremesas, controlando a qualidade dos alimentos, o tempo de preparo e atentando ao sabor, conforme cardápios estipulados;
Orientar auxiliares no pré-preparo de refeições, mantendo o padrão de qualidade do serviço;
Efetuar o controle de validade dos alimentos, utilizando o sistema PEPS (primeiro que vence, primeiro que sai) e preenchendo corretamente as etiquetas de identificação e validade;
Zelar pela higiene e organização da cozinha, aplicando métodos corretos de manipulação, higienização e conservação de alimentos;
Providenciar a limpeza de equipamentos, utensílios e instalações após o uso;
Comunicar ao superior imediato qualquer irregularidade na qualidade das mercadorias, bem como a necessidade de reparo ou reposição de utensílios, equipamentos e instalações;
Garantir a segurança individual e coletiva, utilizando corretamente os EPIs exigidos para a função;
Manter-se em conformidade com as normas do hotel, não utilizando adornos durante o período laboral (ex.: alianças, brincos, pulseiras etc.);
Utilizar toucas descartáveis e demais itens de higiene conforme as normas internas;
Cumprir e aplicar as normas e procedimentos previstos no Manual do Colaborador;
Zelar pela guarda, conservação e manutenção dos equipamentos, instrumentos, materiais e local de trabalho;
Operar equipamentos de preparo, aquecimento e refrigeração de alimentos com segurança;
Auxiliar nos preparos de lanches e refeições, conforme escala e orientação do superior;
Zelar pela conservação dos alimentos estocados, garantindo as condições adequadas de armazenamento para evitar perdas e deteriorações;
Participar de treinamentos e capacitações quando convocado;
Cumprir as normas e procedimentos internos do hotel;
Executar tarefas adicionais que possam ser solicitadas pela liderança, desde que relacionadas às rotinas do departamento de cozinha e que sejam oferecidos os insumos e instruções necessários para sua realização.

Vantagens de fazer parte do nosso time:

Salário na média do mercado;
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento profissional;
Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo;
Escala: 6x1 | Horário: 14h às 22h20.

title: Geomechanics Real Time
description:
Job Description

Do you enjoy motivating others to deliver successful solutions for business and customers?

Are you passionate in scientific and engineering methodologies?

Join our team

We are the leader in well construction and production. Our innovative physical and digital solutions improve efficiency, production, and maximize reservoir value. Moreover, Baker Hughes offers its customers technology and solutions that minimize the risk of additional costs during the construction of wells worldwide.

Partner with the best

As a Real Time Geomechanic, you will work individually as a part of multi-discipline team working with an extensive client base.

As a Geomechanics Real Time , you will be responsible for:

  • Performing an advanced pore pressure and wellbore stability analysis;

  • Recognizing drilling related problems and provide solutions to mitigate or eliminate these drilling and abnormal pressure related problems;

  • Managing multiple projects and/or deadlines.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Geology. It is preferable to have a specialty or master's degree in the area of ​​geomechanics;

  • Show great experience of Pore Pressure and Wellbore Stability RT monitoring and on drilling optimization;

  • Demonstrate excellent proficiency and knowledge in abnormal pressure mechanisms, geological and drilling processes;

  • Be native/ fluent in Portuguese and advanced English;

  • Show knowledge of drilling, LWD, mudlogging and wireline tools and measurements.

  • Have experience with Formation Evaluation technologies including Gamma Ray, Azimuthal Gamma Ray, Resistivity, Deep and Extra Deep Resistivity.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • ·       Working partially remotely from home

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities

  • Comprehensive private medical care options

  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs

  • Tailored financial programs

  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits

About Us: We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
Join Us: Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you Let's come together and take energy forward.

Temos em nossa fórmula colaboradores especiais e é com eles que aprendemos a dar o nosso melhor diariamente, nos dedicando às pessoas, nos planejando, sendo eficientes, valorizando as diferenças e tendo o respeito como o nosso princípio ativo.

Buscamos pessoas que queiram crescer junto com a gente e que tenham vontade de fazer a diferença todos os dias Veja o que valorizamos por aqui:

Aqui, cada colaborador é peça-chave no crescimento da escola e no sucesso dos nossos alunos.

title: Líder de Vendas
description:
A Stone:


Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Nossa Cultura:


Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

  • Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é ser um(a) Líder de Vendas - Inside Sales (Inbound/Outbound):
Sua missão será liderar um time de vendas consultivas, acompanhando de perto os indicadores, traçando planos de ação para o alcance do resultado esperado, focando no desenvolvimento dos seus liderados, fornecendo feedbacks constantes, construindo planos de desenvolvimento individual e de carreira e trazendo ações para reforçar a cultura de foco no(a) cliente dentro da companhia.
Principais responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar entregas, indicadores, resultados operacionais e rotinas do time sob sua liderança;
  • Analisar indicadores e construir planos de ação;
  • Desenvolver o time através da construção de PDIs e planos de ação estruturados;
  • Compreender a fundo o mercado que estamos inseridos;
  • Contribuir com novos insights perante fluxos, processos e resultados;
  • Realizar projetos focado na melhoria de processos;
  • Treinar novos colaboradores;
  • Participar do processo de contratação de novos agentes;
  • Conduzir de reuniões de rotina com o time;
  • Garantir a qualidade do processo de venda do time.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia como liderança por no mínimo 6 meses e vontade genuína de liderar pessoas;
  • Graduação superior (sem exigência de curso específico);
  • Conhecimento em Excel para gerar relatórios e fazer análises complexas de indicadores;
  • Habilidade de comunicação e escuta ativa;
  • Habilidade para articulação de problemas com diferentes públicos;
  • Proatividade para aprender e melhorar continuamente.

Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Segunda a sexta e escala esporádica aos finais de semana.

Modelo e Local de trabalho:

  • Presencial | Cinelândia - Rio de Janeiro/ RJ.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo


Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes essenciais. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte

Apresentação Pessoal: Este é o momento de te conhecermos Você deverá preencher o questionário de vida com o objetivo de apresentar sua trajetória, hobbies e motivações e sonhos.

Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

title: Volunteer System Manager
description:
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027").

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department's main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in-line with FIFA's data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision-making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct "Train-the-Trainer" sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost-effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close-out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.

  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross-functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large-scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.

  • Education: Master's in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large-scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi-stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community-building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Consultoria Negócios Institucionais III
description:
Sobre a Abbott

A Abbott é líder global em saúde, desenvolvendo uma ciência inovadora para melhorar a saúde das pessoas. Estamos sempre olhando para o futuro, antecipando mudanças na ciência e em tecnologias médicas.

Trabalhando na Abbott

Na Abbott, você pode realizar um trabalho importante, crescer e aprender, cuidar de si mesmo e de sua família, ser você mesmo e viver de maneira plena. Você terá acesso a:

  • Desenvolvimento de carreira em uma empresa internacional onde é possível crescer na carreira dos seus sonhos.
  • Uma empresa reconhecida mundialmente como um ótimo lugar para se trabalhar em dezenas de países e nomeada como uma das empresas mais admiradas do mundo pela revista Fortune.
  • Entre as melhores grandes empresas para se trabalhar, bem como um dos melhores lugares para se trabalhar nas categorias de diversidade mães que trabalham, executivas e cientistas.

A oportunidade

Esta posição tem local de trabalho em Rio de Janeiro/RJ na Divisão de Medicamentos de Marca e Produtos Farmacêuticos.

Estamos comprometidos em prover os benefícios de nossos medicamentos de confiança para mais pessoas nos países que mais crescem e se desenvolvem no mundo. Nosso amplo portfólio de medicamentos de marca de alta qualidade e diferenciados alcança múltiplas áreas terapêuticas, incluindo gastroenterologia, saúde feminina, cardiometabólico, sistema nervoso central, respiratório, produtos de consumer health care e vacina contra a gripe.

O que você vai fazer

  • Analisar e entender a jornada do produto dentro das contas de sua responsabilidade, para identificar desafios e oportunidades;
  • Desenvolver estratégias de abordagem dentro da conta, identificando os médicos e stakeholders corretos;
  • Fornecer informações científicas e benefícios do produto aos profissionais de saúde, maximizando as oportunidades;
  • Participar de congressos e eventos médicos;
  • Analisar informações de inteligência de mercado de seu setor e propor planos de ação para otimização de resultados;
  • Desenvolver planos de negócios e implementar atividades relacionadas, como eventos de clientes, campanhas de marketing;
  • Compartilhar as percepções do cliente com as partes interessadas internas relevantes de forma contínua para apoiar o desenvolvimento de conteúdo, campanhas e planos de interação relacionados ao produto e à indicação;
  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para criar e implementar soluções que atendam às necessidades não atendidas de clientes e pacientes.

Qualificações necessárias

  • Superior completo
  • Pós-graduação em Negócios ou áreas relacionadas - será um diferencial
  • Experiência prévia em mercados de alta complexidade (non retail) - mandatória
  • Experiência em Oncologia/Biossimilares
  • Experiência em mercado privado e gestão de contas - será um diferencial importante
  • Experiência com planejamento e lançamento de novos produtos - será um diferencial
  • Comportamentos acima da média e perfil empreendedor
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade analítica para identificação de oportunidades
  • Disponibilidade para viagens
  • Necessário ter CNH ativa

Candidate-se agora

Siga suas aspirações de carreira nas diversas oportunidades da Abbott, uma empresa que pode ajudar você a construir seu futuro e viver da melhor maneira possível. A Abbott é uma companhia que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, estando comprometida com a diversidade de colaboradores.

title: Linux Engineering Manager
description:
Lead an engineering team that partners with the Linux engineers of a major silicon company, and works across the full Linux stack from kernel to GUI, to optimise Ubuntu, the world's most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.

The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that's challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.

As a Partner Engineering Manager at Canonical your role is to manage relationships with our key technology partners by ensuring timely delivery on agreed project milestones. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. 

What you'll do

  • Lead a team of distributed engineers to design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Engage with commercial partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms
  • Develop your team through coaching, mentoring, leading by example, and feedback
  • Oversee commercial engagements and support timely delivery on agreed project milestones
  • Ensure an ongoing commitment to strict quality and reliability standards
  • Engage with other teams at Canonical to ensure alignment on product architecture and roadmaps
  • Work from home with global travel up to twice a year for up to two weeks

Who you are

  • You have worked with Linux distributions, debian packaging and high performance, server-class hardware
  • You have experience working directly with customers, resolving their technical issues, interpreting their business challenges and effectively communicating how your solution will meet their needs
  • You have demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers
  • You have understanding of agile software development methodologies
  • You collaborate effectively across multiple internal teams, building trust and delivering results
  • You have effective communications skills in English, both written and oral
  • You have a bachelor's (or equivalent university level) degree, preferably in a technology field

What Canonical offers

  • Learning and Development opportunities
  • Annual Compensation Review
  • Recognition Rewards
  • Annual Leave
  • Priority Pass for travel

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity we will give your application fair consideration

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

title: Quality Engineer, Product QA
description:
The Quality Engineer, Product QA (Welding discipline)will be responsible for:

  • Support product engineering on welding requirements identification, review and implementation.

  • To develop project welding matrix aligned with Material's Engineering Team.

  • To qualify product welding processes in-house and review supplier's qualification processes.

  • Record properly the welding qualifications on PQRs and WPS.

  • Review and approve local work instructions for welding.

  • Implement and control welding consumables best practices and requirements, including the required approvals per relevant industry codes.

  • Oversight welding operations in-house and in suppliers as per ABNT NBR 14842 duties.

  • Witness laboratory tests for welding and welder qualifications and report out.

  • To control welder qualification record and its performance according to relevant standards.

  • Deploy continuous improvement actions on welding operations based on product performance.

  • Support Project Quality team for welding discipline across the live projects.

  • Interface with customer SME in welding during project execution.

  • Ensure critical observations e concerns are properly identified and escalated to the respective levels of the organization.

  • Run product quality audits and walks in a frequent basis to certify project requirements are flowed down.

  • Support lead Go No Go process for fabrication start and facilitate pre-production meeting.

  • Ensure welding Lessons Learned are properly captured, solved and communicated to product delivery and supply team.

  • Ensure product non-conformances are properly identified, recorded by the relevant point of contact responsible for fabrication.

  • Witness product inspections and processes/product qualification inspections as per the relevant inspection and test plan, and report-out.

  • Review and approve the supplier quality welding records.

  • Handle communication with direct colleagues and the business about approach and methods for solving complex problems

  • Adhere to Product Line directive for standard quality requirements in fabrication sites.

  • Contribute in the root cause analises of welding non-conformances/problems

  • Support the Quality in team in NDE inspections applicability / improvements in-house or in suppliers

  • Review and approve weld maps.

Required Characteristics

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college in (Mechanical, Welding, Materials or Production discipline).

  • Fluent in English.

  • Knowledge in local Brazilian customer quality requirements related to fabrication of subsea equipment including XT, Manifolds and Tooling.

  • Strong and proven experience on welding discipline for subsea equipment.

  • Experience in Quality audits to support customer project assessments.

  • Knowledge in product quality inspection and documentation analysis.

  • Experience with customer interface.

  • Knowledge of NDE inspections (MP, DP, UT, PAUT, etc)

  • Knowledge of usual materials used in the Oil&Gas industry

  • Welding Inspector Qualification (FBTS Level 2)

  • Knowledge of usual materials used in the Oil&Gas industry

Desired Characteristics

  • Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.

  • Ability to influence others and lead small teams. Lead initiatives of moderate scope and impact.

  • Ability to coordinate several projects simultaneously. Effective problem identification and solution skills. Proven analytical and organizational ability.

Location:Curitiba, PR.

title: Junior Customer Support Specialist
description:
Full time

LATAM, Brasil, Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, US

B2B

Synerise is not just another tech company. It is a space where our brilliant team consequently brings technology change to the business world and instead of following known paths, we are creating a new one – a next-generation, fully personalized and AI-driven customer experience.

We successfully deliver an all-in-one tool - Synerise (YouTube link). An ever-evolving behavioral data platform, enhanced by AI to generate outstanding ROI in more than 30 markets for industry leaders in Retail, Banking, eCommerce, Automotive, Insurance, and Telco, processing more than 150 billion transactions annually. However, we don't limit ourselves solely to this solution. We're building BaseModel (website link) - a foundation model for behavioral data embedded within a novel platform for enterprise Data Science teams, that is another step on our path to create innovation in AI and demonstrate its potential for the business world.

‍

Having such great solutions, we are looking for a highly motivated Customer Success&Implementation Managerto join our Customer Success & Implementation Department (CSI).

‍

What will you do on a daily basis?

  • Oversee the onboarding of new and existing customers to ensure a quicker "Time To Production".
  • Cooperate with Synerise Partners during the implementation of Synerise AI Solutions at companies from various sectors (e-commerce, finance, retail, telco, etc).
  • Ensure that all support tickets are resolved within each partners/customers SLA and proactively manage escalations.
  • Identify new use cases and achieve the customers & partners' satisfaction, expansions, upsells, and new opportunities with the partners.
  • Participate in the creation of educational content for our partners (such as user guides, use cases, FAQ knowledge base, etc).
  • Take care of the continuous development of customer and partner sales and technical competencies.
  • Cooperate with Business Development & IT Departments in terms of agile project management.
  • Influence Synerise Roadmap and internal processes.

‍

What will make us a perfect match?

  • Native Spanish.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken.
  • Based in South America.
  • Experience in related customer-facing roles.
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly those that apply to a "Big Data" environment.
  • Willingness to cooperate with customers in the form of a ticket as well as providing technical training.
  • Experience in working with tools from the area of marketing automation/digital marketing/Big Data.
  • Multitasking ability.
  • Excellent planning, organizational, and execution skills.
  • High motivation for self-development and a desire to acquire knowledge.
  • "Digital nativity" & excellence with operating desktop & mobile devices.

‍

What will convince us even more?

  • Fluent in Brazilian Portuguese
  • Familiarity with big data & AI concepts.
  • Experience working with BI tools.
  • Experience with low-code solutions.
  • Familiarity with process automation tools & marketing automation platforms.
  • Experience in web development projects.
  • Experience in mobile development projects.
  • Experience with REST API and familiarity with webhooks concepts.
  • Experience with Postman or similar software.
  • Knowledge of Vanillia Java Script.
  • Knowledge of HTML5/ CSS3/ RDW.

What can we provide for you?

  • An opportunity to work in a fast-growing company in the field of AI and marketing automation.
  • Possibility to have a real impact on promoting and raising awareness of Synerise solutions among potential customers, business partners, and the industry community.
  • Freedom to act.
  • Flat structure with ample ownership opportunities.
  • Membership in a 30+ person Customer Success & Implementation Department, a team of tech professionals that are focused on relationships and a good atmosphere in the team.
  • The opportunity for professional development in various career paths (data analysis, project management, integration, etc.).
  • Integration events where we focus on the atmosphere and relations between people.
  • Daily adrenaline rushes and much, much more.

Benefits & Perks

‍Flexible working hours


Are you an early bird or a night owl? Choose when and where you want to work.

‍No dress code


Dress up, dress down, just get dressed in whatever way makes you comfortable.

‍Power-ups


We want to feel good. We provide everyone with a package of healthy snacks, private medical health care and a multisport card.

‍Play & fun


Like to enrich your work with a little bit of entertainment? We do it regularly during Let's Talk and Have a Beer meetings, weekly football matches with Synerise Team or while playing with our dogs.

title: Agriculture Reporter
description:
Agriculture Reporter - Brazil (Rio)

Location

Rio de Janeiro

Business Area

News and Media

Ref #

Description & Requirements


We are seeking an experienced reporter to drive our agriculture coverage in Brazil — one of the world's most dynamic and influential economies for commodities. You'll take on a crucial beat focused on soft commodities such as coffee, cocoa, and sugar, with a strong emphasis on ethanol. Your reporting will span market movements, global trading trends, government policy, corporate strategy, farmer sentiment, and consumer and environmental issues. The ideal candidate will have a deep curiosity about how Brazil's agricultural sector operates — from farms to boardrooms — and a keen sense of how developments there ripple across global markets and economies.

Brazil has rapidly become an agricultural powerhouse, reshaping global trade and intensifying debates around s

ustainability.

You'll be responsible for delivering agenda-setting journalism that captures this transformation — from scoops and breaking news to deeply reported enterprise pieces.

Working alongside colleagues in Brazil and across Bloomberg's global network, you'll stay on top of news affecting commodities futures, corporate moves and M&A, regulation and policy — and help bring clarity and insight to our global audience. Along with soft commodities, you'll be responsible for pulp and paper.

This position can be done from Rio or Sao Paulo. To be considered, please submit your application by Friday, December 5.

Resumes must be submitted in English to be considered

We'll trust you to:

  • Monitor and explain market moves on major commodities, writing with precision and insight for sophisticated readers
  • Be a self-starter, and someone who can thrive in a fast-paced news environment
  • Generate original story and project ideas that vividly illustrate how Brazil's commodities markets influence traders, farmers, corporations, and consumers.
  • Interpret and analyze the affects of tariffs on markets and trade
  • Break news on issues including policymaking and environmental developments
  • Collaborate closely with colleagues across teams, bureaus and continents to deliver a global perspective to our readers

You'll need to have:

  • At least 5 years of experience in business or financial journalism
  • Experience in a real-time news environment
  • A proven track record reporting and writing about business in Brazil
  • Demonstrated success in building your own sources to break news
  • An ability to write quickly and clearly under deadline pressure
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Demonstrated continuous career growth and initiative within an organization
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

We'd love to see:

  • Familiarity with journalism across platforms, including digital, video, podcasts and data visualization
  • Preferably experience covering agriculture or other commodities

title: Field Agent
description:
Result of Service

The Field Agent reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Expected duration

Three (3) months, with possibility of renewal

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. The Social Territories Programme has been implemented since 2019, first in large favela complexes (Alemão, Chapadão, Cidade de Deus, Lins, Maré, Pedreira, Penha, Jacarezinho, Rocinha and Vila Kennedy), and currently in larger scale throughout the city. To properly continue the Social Territories Programme's implementation, a Field Agent is required to support field research activities in designated areas of the city. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Field Agent reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Field Agent will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Apply questionnaires to selected families in designated areas as determined in the Programme's workplan. b) Work collaboratively with other Field Agents and his/her Local Manager to meet individual and collective quota for their designated areas. c) Visit and assist selected families at the request of the Programme Coordination. d) Provide logistical and operational support in local events. e) Participate in local meetings. f) Attend training and information sessions. g) Disseminate information about the Programme in designated areas. h) Elaborate and deliver a Monthly Activity Report in a timely manner. i) Be responsible, within its competencies, to ensure that technical activities are aligned with quality expectations of the Agency and its counterparts. j) Perform other duties which may be requested by the Programme's team. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Field Agent will carry out field research and support the Programme's active search, integrated service and monitoring activities. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office of monthly activities' report.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• High School Diploma is required, or additional two (2) years or relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Work experience:
• Minimum one (1) year of experience in research, data collection and/or conducting interviews/questionnaires, preferably in the intervened/vulnerable communities, is required.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Good handling of technological tools is required.
• Knowledge and experience with data collection applications, such as Survey123, is desirable.
• Good computer skills in Windows, such as Microsoft Office and Microsoft Excel, is desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.

Additional Information

Travel details: Not Applicable. Remuneration SB-2/1 – BRL: 2.389,08 (net amount) UNDP Brazil Salary Scale Notes Appointment against this post is on local basis and only nationals from Brazil or external candidates who hold a permanent visa in Brazil may apply. The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. It is required for all the curricular information to be inserted in the system, which may take a few hours. Only complete applications in English will be considered. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence. Due to the volume of applications received, receipt of applications cannot be acknowledged individually. Only short-listed applicants will be contacted. Applications should be submitted through INSPIRA and must include all documents required at the system, please be ready to include the following information at the "Candidate Profile" (CP) at Inspira:
• Cover memo (maximum 1 page)
• Educational Background (incl. dates)
• Professional Experience (assignments, tasks, achievements, duration by years/ months)
• Expertise and preferences regarding location of potential assignments
• Other Experience and Expertise (e.g. Internships/ voluntary work, etc.)* * Please note that Internships, self-employment and part-time count as 50%. In addition to it, note experience not relevant to the position will not be considered. All applications should be submitted to: Inspira UN-HABITAT does not charge a fee at any stage of the recruitment process. If you have any questions concerning people or companies claiming to be recruiting on behalf of these offices and requesting the payment of a fee, please contact:

No Fee

THE UNITED NATIONS DOES NOT CHARGE A FEE AT ANY STAGE OF THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS (APPLICATION, INTERVIEW MEETING, PROCESSING, OR TRAINING). THE UNITED NATIONS DOES NOT CONCERN ITSELF WITH INFORMATION ON APPLICANTS' BANK ACCOUNTS.

  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob prazos e múltiplas demandas;

  • Proatividade e boa comunicação/interlocução com o time;

Nós oferecemos:

Vale-Refeição ou Vale-Alimentação (você decide como dividir);

Gympass, para te ajudar a ficar em dia com a sua saúde;

Dress code descontraído;

Day off no mês do aniversário para essa data não passar sem festa;

Uma sexta-feira off por mês (ou um dia de folga por mês, a ser alinhado com a gestão da área);

Plano de carreira: queremos te ver voando com a gente

Acreditamos que um time diverso é o caminho para cumprir a nossa missão de transformar vidas e o Brasil. Assim, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas que se identifiquem com grupos minorizados em todas as nossas posições.

Não podemos escolher o que sentimos, mas podemos aprender o que fazer com nossos sentimentos. Já pensou nisso?

Para isso, buscamos pessoas que se identifiquem com o nosso propósito e compartilhem da nossa vontade de espalhar o jeito LIV, impactando as comunidades escolares de todo o Brasil.

Vem com a gente nessa jornada?

Aqui você vai encontrar:

Pessoas colaborativas - Acreditamos que juntos somos capazes de encontrar as melhores soluções;

Crescimento com responsabilidade e propósito - Reconhecemos que a ética e o impacto pedagógico são inegociáveis no nosso dia a dia;

Cuidado e escuta com quem faz o LIV - Valorizamos o cuidado e o respeito como partes imprescindíveis do nosso trabalho, por isso somos empáticos e acolhedores;

Visão em movimento - Somos inquietos, propositivos e inovamos para entregar a melhor experiência socioemocional;

Compromisso com a nossa comunidade - Tomamos decisões a partir do que as nossas escolas têm a dizer, praticando a escuta ativa e a cultura de feedbacks.

Por que trabalhar conosco?

A Concessionária
A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizará o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. Programa Respeito dá o Tom
O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

A partir de 2020 passou por uma revisão e seu objetivo foi reconfigurado: espelhar a população negra em todos os níveis hierárquicos.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

title: Gerente Sênior de Crescimento
description:
Descrição e Responsabilidades:
Horário: 9h às 18h
Nível: Managerial and Executive
Regime de contratação: Fixed Term

1. COMO É SER GERENTE (SÊNIOR) DE CRESCIMENTO EM MSF-BRASIL:

Você irá desenvolver e liderar a estratégia do funil de crescimento e de melhoria contínua do retorno sobre investimento das ações de captação de recursos de MSF-Brasil, maximizando a contribuição para os projetos médico-humanitários da organização pelo mundo. Irá trabalhar para encantar, conquistar e fidelizar pessoas doadoras por meio de engajamento contínuo, diversificando canais e garantindo a sustentabilidade do programa de captação de recursos de MSF-Brasil a longo prazo.

Além disso, deverá desenvolver e incentivar estratégias ousadas, inovadoras, orientadas por dados e que reforcem a marca de MSF, fomentando uma relação com pessoas doadoras pautadas pela ética e transparência, visando sempre a segurança e privacidade de dados. Atuando em estreita colaboração com outras lideranças, garantindo uma abordagem alinhada com a estratégia de MSF-Brasil como um todo e assegurando que o crescimento seja conduzido de forma ética, inclusiva e responsável, considerando a diversidade de públicos, contextos e impactos das estratégias adotadas.

2. QUAIS SERÃO SEUS DESAFIOS?

  • Ampliar a base de pessoas doadoras ativas de MSF-Brasil, buscando caminhos inovadores para enfrentar os diferentes desafios no mercado e considerando cada etapa do funil de crescimento;
  • Aumentar a receita de MSF-Brasil, garantindo eficiência nas atividades de crescimento e buscando maximizar Retorno sobre Investimento (ROI);
    Promover cultura de captação de recursos na organização, equilibrando crescimento, inovação e performance com decisões éticas, inclusivas e alinhadas aos valores institucionais.

3. COMO É O DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO?

Atividades de Crescimento e Estratégia

  • Zelar pela qualidade das entregas da célula, junto aos responsáveis das áreas, garantindo o atendimento às demandas com qualidade;
  • Assegurar que os processos de compras, pagamentos e reports são cumpridos pela célula de acordo com os prazos definidos;
  • Garantir gestão e monitoramento completo do funil de crescimento, desde a consciência e aquisição de pessoas doadoras até a fidelização e indicação, e identificação de oportunidades para otimizar o desempenho em cada etapa do funil por meio do monitoramento constante de métricas;
  • Garantir experimentação e implementação de novos canais e abordagens para expandir alcance e performance junto às lideranças da célula e em colaboração estreita com o time de Business Intelligence (BI);
  • Garantir otimização constante da experiência de pessoas usuárias, Régua de Relacionamento e atendimento a pessoas doadoras, zelando pela qualidade de cada contato e considerando abordagem inovadora e omnichannel;
  • Assegurar que experiências, réguas e abordagens considerem diferentes perfis, capacidades de acesso, contextos culturais e expectativas, evitando práticas excludentes e fortalecendo relações sustentáveis com pessoas doadoras;
  • Trabalhar com líderes na célula para melhorar processos e fluxos junto às outras células no hub de Engajamento Estratégico em busca de melhor eficiência e agilidade nas atividades;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com o time de Filantropia no planejamento e implementação de estratégias para desenvolver pessoas doadoras, tanto pessoas físicas quanto jurídicas, visando aumentar suas contribuições e direcioná-los à categoria de grandes doações, com atendimento personalizado pela equipe de Filantropia;
  • Garantir potencial de otimização da área de sistemas junto a Gerência de Sistemas e GTT através de investimentos em novas tecnologias;
  • Garantir que a célula de crescimento contribui e segue processos de certificação de PCI compliance de MSF e segurança de dados conforme LGPD e políticas de MSF;
  • Negociar as melhores condições de parceria de fornecedores de MSF-Brasil junto as lideranças na célula;
  • Contribuir para projetos de alto nível do Hub de Engajamento Estratégico, conforme necessário;
  • Desenvolver e liderar a estratégia do funil de crescimento de MSF-Brasil, envolvendo as áreas interessadas e garantindo participação ativa de suas equipes na construção;
  • Definir, sustentar e responsabilizar-se pela incorporação de princípios de diversidade, equidade e inclusão nas estratégias, decisões, prioridades e práticas da célula de crescimento, influenciando lideranças, equipes e parceiros e promovendo um ambiente seguro, ético e coerente com os valores de MSF;
  • Garantir participação e acompanhamento de plataformas internacionais relevantes para MSF-Brasil, trazendo ideias inovadoras e adaptando para o cenário brasileiro;

Promoção de cultura de Captação de Recursos

  • Ser responsável pela construção de uma cultura de captação de recursos em MSF-Brasil, garantindo a consistência dos programas oferecidos para as pessoas funcionarias, conscientizando a organização sobre a importância de captação de recursos e relacionamento com as pessoas doadoras;
  • Compartilhar insights e performance da área com outros departamentos da organização continuamente, assegurando trabalho transversal;
  • Participar e contribuir com o fórum de ONGs no Brasile plataformas internacionais, trazendo insumos relevantes do mercado e ideias inovadoras, adaptando para o cenário de MSF-Brasil;
    Influenciar a cultura organizacional para que práticas de captação e relacionamento sejam compreendidas e realizadas de forma ética, inclusiva e alinhada aos valores institucionais;

Compromissos de gestão de MSF-Brasil

  • Atuar de forma alinhada aos valores e princípios da organização, promovendo uma gestão de pessoas ética, equitativa e inclusiva, que valorize a escuta ativa, fomente uma cultura de feedback contínuo e incentive o desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Aplicar e disseminar as diretrizes éticas de MSF-Brasil e os Compromissos Comportamentais da organização, assegurando um ambiente de trabalho respeitoso, transparente e coerente com os princípios da organização;
  • Favorecer a colaboração entre áreas e o trabalho transversal, desenvolvendo e aprimorando processos integrados com olhar estratégico;
  • Contribuir ativamente para o Planejamento Estratégico e Plano Anual, participando de monitoramentos periódicos, identificando riscos e ajustando prioridades com responsabilidade e visão sistêmica;
  • Garantir a implementação e promoção ativa de práticas de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI), valorizando diferentes perspectivas, combatendo qualquer forma de discriminação e promovendo um ambiente seguro para todas as pessoas;

Promoção de cultura ágil e contribuição para mudança

  • Adotar metodologias ágeis, incentivando ciclos curtos de entrega, aprendizado contínuo e adaptação às mudanças;
  • Estimular a criatividade e a experimentação, propondo soluções inovadoras e ousadas que ampliem a relevância e o engajamento de MSF-Brasil junto ao público brasileiro;
  • Basear e incentivar decisões em dados e evidências, fortalecendo a transparência, a eficiência e o foco em resultados;
    Atuar como agente de mudança no processo de transformação do Hub, contribuindo para a implementação de novas formas de trabalhar, incluindo cultura "data-driven" e metodologia ágil.

Requisitos:

4. O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER?

  • Formação relevante na área
  • Sólida experiência em liderança de crescimento e captação de recursos
  • Experiência com gestão de pessoas e canais diversos de marketing
  • Ter domínio do inglês (avançado)
  • Conhecimentos de estratégia de marketing e análise de resultados, propostas, tendências
  • Conhecimentos de metodologia ágil e gestão de projetos
  • Conhecimentos de CRMs, bancos de dados e Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD)
  • Conhecimentos de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão e aplicação em liderança

5. O QUE AUMENTA SUAS CHANCES?

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas relacionadas
  • Experiência prévia em Médicos Sem Fronteiras ou outras organizações do terceiro setor
  • Vivência com estratégias de crescimento voltadas para causas humanitárias ou sociais

6. QUAIS SÃO AS COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS?

Você precisará ter pensamento analítico para selecionar os métodos ou conceitos mais eficazes e apropriados para analisar situações, propor soluções e facilitar a tomada de decisões, além de resultado e orientação para qualidade para buscar eficiência em todos os aspectos do trabalho com monitoramento contínuo. Também será necessário ter iniciativa e inovação para aplicar metodologias que estimulem a criatividade e a inovação dos outros, bem como habilidades de liderança para encorajar, envolver e motivar muitas pessoas, responsabilizando-se pelos resultados finais.

Esta é uma posição por tempo determinado, com término previsto para dezembro de 2026. Logo, a duração de contrato irá depender da data de contração.

PRINCÍPIOS E CULTURA DE SALVAGUARDA:

MSF está em busca de pessoas que compartilhem do compromisso com uma cultura de salvaguarda, que visa garantir um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas. Buscamos promover e garantir a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas ações e práticas. Assim, fortalecemos nossa missão e asseguramos que todas as pessoas tenham a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer na organização. Candidaturas que demonstrem alinhamento com esses valores serão altamente valorizadas.

Alinhada com os valores que orientam as ações da nossa organização em todo o mundo, priorizamos a candidatura de pessoas que cumpram os requisitos estabelecidos e se identifiquem como parte de um ou mais grupos minorizados, como Pessoas Negras (Pretas e Pardas), Indígenas, Trans e PcD.

Venha fazer parte da equipe de Médicos Sem Fronteiras Brasil

RETORNO:

Ficamos muito felizes com o seu interesse em trabalhar em MSF Gostaríamos de reforçar que, ao final do processo, todas as pessoas candidatas receberão um retorno sobre sua participação.

title: Gerente Financeiro
description:
A BR MANIA é uma empresa 100% VIBRA e opera de forma independente. Atuamos na gestão de negócios de conveniência e proximidade no brasil, gerenciando uma das marcas mais queridas do Brasil.

Temos o compromisso de proporcionar uma experiência única aos nossos clientes, oferecendo produtos de alta qualidade e um atendimento excepcional. Como parte da nossa equipe, você será um protagonista em contribuir para o crescimento de uma empresa inovadora, com foco no desenvolvimento humano e na melhoria contínua. Vamos tornar o mundo mais conveniente, prático e próximo dos consumidores, com soluções cada vez mais inovadoras e sustentáveis.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Atuar de forma estratégica e operacional, liderando a gestão das áreas contábil, fiscal, controladoria, tesouraria, planejamento financeiro, auditorias, controles internos e suprimentos. O profissional será responsável por definir diretrizes, propor melhorias e tomar decisões que impactem diretamente os resultados e o crescimento sustentável da empresa.

  • Planejar e supervisionar junto ao gestor da área Contábil o fechamento de resultados e a elaboração das demonstrações financeiras, garantindo informações confiáveis para tomada de decisão.
  • Gerenciar o reporte mensal para consolidação na controladora, alinhando estratégias financeiras.
  • Coordenar auditorias externas e internas, promovendo transparência e conformidade.
  • Gerenciar a publicação das demonstrações financeiras e a Assembleia Geral Ordinária, fortalecendo a governança corporativa.
  • Garantir o cumprimento das obrigações contábeis e atualização de normas técnicas.
  • Administrar e desenvolver junto ao gestor da área tributário estratégias para gestão eficiente de múltiplos CNPJs.
  • Planejar e controlar a apuração e pagamento de tributos, otimizando recursos e minimizando riscos fiscais.
  • Supervisionar a entrega de obrigações acessórias fiscais.
  • Implementar práticas de compliance fiscal, assegurando conformidade e aproveitamento de créditos.
  • Mapear oportunidades tributárias em novos produtos/operações e liderar processos de recuperação de créditos.
  • Liderar junto ao gestor dá área de controladoria o planejamento financeiro e o ciclo orçamentário, alinhando metas estratégicas.
  • Gerenciar o controle orçamentário e análise de investimentos, apoiando decisões de expansão e rentabilidade.
  • Analisar junto a área o desempenho de vendas e propor ações para maximizar resultados.
  • Definir e acompanhar metas corporativas e governança da rede.
  • Supervisionar suprimentos corporativos, buscando eficiência e redução de custos.
  • Estruturar junto ao gestor da área de tesouraria processos de contas a receber e a pagar, garantindo liquidez e saúde financeira.
  • Gerenciar o fluxo de caixa, aplicações financeiras e dívidas, apoiando decisões estratégicas de investimento.
  • Definir e acompanhar KPIs financeiros para suportar a estratégia da empresa.
  • Gerenciar e monitorar KPIs financeiros e operacionais, orientando decisões estratégicas.
  • Gerenciar inadimplência e atuar juridicamente para proteger os interesses da empresa.
  • Controlar processos internos e propor melhorias contínuas em rebates, royalties, TI e expansão.
  • Liderar junto ao gestor da auditoria, promovendo evolução dos controles e mitigação de riscos.
  • Garantir junto ao time a implementação de melhorias nos processos e controles internos, visando excelência operacional.
  • Gerenciar a divulgação oficial dos resultados, reduzindo prazos e aumentando a eficiência.
  • Administrar e suportar o gestor da área de suprimentos estrategicamente com fornecedores, buscando melhores condições e parcerias.
  • Supervisionar pedidos de compra e cadastro de fornecedores/materiais no SAP.
  • Atuar como interface estratégica com o jurídico para contratos.
